'''Tarson Kestrel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Along with fellow Human [[Sundro Tam]], Kestrel acted as one of the leaders of a band of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] raiders that where hired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] to transport shipments of spice to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], where Mika converted the spice into [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]]&mdash;a more potent variety of the drug. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Kestrel set out aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Barabi Run]]'' on a standard assignment to ship a cargo of spice to Varl, but after the vessel departed from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the vicinity of the world [[Rhilithan]], it was captured by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] vessels [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']] and [[Vigilance (Etti light cruiser)|''Vigilance'']]. The CSA imprisoned Kestrel and his crew, and requisitioned the ''Barabi Run'' for use on a CSA assignment.

==Personality and traits==
Kestrel was a ruthless individual, with a fatalistic outlook on life, and he would rather [[Death/Legends|die]] while fighting than flee from combat and escape.
